title: Different Rails for Different Purposes: The Nuance of Simplifying Modern Banking
summary: At EBADay in Copenhagen, Craig Ramsey, Global Head of A2A Payments, ACI Worldwide joined the FinextraTV studio to discuss the changes in Instant Payments. Addressing growth, Ramsey said that initiatives like Wero are really taking off at speed and the crucial point now is ensuring that banks can still keep up with these changes and scale reliably. Ramsey described how different each rail looks, comparing ACH to Swift to Instant to RTGS and how each has different scales of complexities and the world, according to Ramsey, will only get more complex - it's banks job to simplify the offering.
